item.mng: čoγ-tai ökin tngri-yin arban qoyar ner-e-tü
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini ǰin-a mitr-a kiged yeke dokiyalduγuluγči kelemürči bande yesesde orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai, kümün-ü eǰen dai erketü delekei-dekin-ü qormusda-yin ǰarliq-iyar samdan sengge töbed-ün kelen-eče mongγol-un kelen-dür orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai

item.mng: čoγ-tai ökin tngri-yin arban qoyar ner-e-tü
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini ǰin-a mitr-a kiged yeke dokiyalduγuluγči kelemürči bande yesesde orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai, kümün-ü eǰen dai erketü delekei-dekin-ü qormusda-yin ǰarliq-iyar samdan sengge töbed-ün kelen-eče mongγol-un kelen-dür orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai

item.mng: čoγ-dai ökin tngri arban qoyar ner-e,
item.coloph: hindkeg-ün ubadiy-a ǰina miḓr-a kiged, yeke / öčigči kelemürči pandi yeses sḓê orčiγulǰu nayiraγuluγad orčiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-tür küḓga, odser maṇǰusiri baṇḓida-tur / dulduyidču mati baḓr-a sagar-a siri badr-a toyin čorǰi orčiγulbai. , .

item.mng: čoγtai ökin tngri-yin arban qoyar neretü
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini jin-a mitr-a kiged, yeke dokiyalduγuluγči kelemürči bandê yê sêsdi <orčiγul-un> nayiraγulǰu / orosiγulbai. kümün-ü eǰen dai erketü delekei-tekin-ü qormusta-yin ǰarliγ-iyar samdan sengge töbed-ün / kelen-eče mongγol-un kelen-tür orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai. , .
